title: rapuntium foliosum
intro: Rapuntium foliosum, commonly known as prickly lettuce, is a plant species that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). Prickly lettuce is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as a diuretic, which can help with weight loss. The therapeutic actions of prickly lettuce include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of prickly lettuce include flavonoids, sesquiterpene lactones, and sesquiterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
